correctness.rationale: The simultaneous normal form follows from commuting idempotent equations: product-image roots are exactly common fixed points; U and V points attach uniquely to a root, while each remaining point has its two images in a compatible U/V fiber. The converse constructs valid commuting idempotents and proves bijectivity. This yields the formal EGF and explicit multinomial coefficient formula with exact rank support for every n. The independent direct checker compares all triples for n=1..5, all commuting pairs for n=6, and the rooted recurrence through n=11. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-n bijection.

value.rationale: The three image ranks of commuting idempotent endofunctions are natural centralizer and finite semilattice-action invariants. The result classifies all realizable rank triples and enumerates each exactly for every finite size, with a positive component species and a finite integer recurrence. It is a complete nontrivial infinite-family structural enumeration, not an arbitrary single-parameter table or small finite census; no independent or downstream theorem is asserted.
